title: Simple Utils
description: A simple mod to make more materials renewable.
body:
This mod aims to add ways to farm materials that normally wouldn't be renewable. It currently adds a way to make renewable netherrack via [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create), using multiple steps to go from crimson wood to netherrack. This is added to prevent the lag from mining or the need for extensive nether quarries to get Cinder flour, as that doesn't seem to be sustainable for long playthroughs.

Other processing lines are planned, but are currently not being worked on.
